title: PistonHeads events
content:
We love events here at PistonHeads. Whether you’re looking for an excuse to get out for a drive, an opportunity to show off your wheels and chat to likeminded enthusiasts or watch some racing, we’ll have something to tickle your fancy.
You’ll find a PistonHeads event on the calendar most months, with Sunday Services taking place throughout the year along with exclusive offers and opportunities to attend events with us.
Take a look at everything that we and other members have to offer below. If you don’t already receive our newsletter, update your preferences here so you don’t miss another event ever again.
More events will be added here when they become available.
PistonHeads Sunday Service
The church for car lovers; join us at unique venues around the UK. In its most basic form, the foundation of a PistonHeads Sunday Service is to find somewhere for members to meet up, enjoy a drive out, have a nose around each other’s cars and grab some breakfast.
Our Sunday Services have evolved over the years to take in visits to incredible venues including manufacturer headquarters, factory tours, Q&As, museums, track days and motorsport events. Our most popular events can fill in less than 24 hours, so we generally only release the details up to a month before they happen.
To ensure you don’t miss out, keep an eye on our Events forum and sign up to our newsletter to hear about them as they go live.
Our annual pilgrimage to Le Mans has been taking place for over a decade and remains the highlight of our event calendar. Hundreds of PistonHeads members make the journey south with us and our longstanding partner 1st Tickets to the legendary 24 Hour race every year, as well as the biennial Le Mans Classic.
You can find more information on these events here.
All events will launch with a news story on our homepage with specific details on how to sign up. When we release a PistonHeads event where we manage the attendance ourselves, it’ll be added to our calendar here. If you’re not a member, it’s quick and free to sign up.
You should only put your name down if you’re 100% sure you can attend, as we have limited capacity at venues. If you take a spot and don’t turn up, someone else will miss out so if you can no longer attend, please remove yourself from the calendar as soon as possible.
For most events, we will email out a pass generally on the Friday before, which you’ll need to print out and show on the gate to gain access. If you’ve got any questions, start a thread in the relevant events forum or drop us a line at info@pistonheads.com
